in_scope.instructions:
This is PhonePe Business App For Merchants in iOS version.
The app needs a Indian mobile phone number and bank account to register. Video KYC process is followed for production apps to validate registered users.

General Description:
The PhonePe Business App is your gateway to a digital payments acceptance network spanning 3.8 Crore merchants! You can set up your business account & accept payments, track transactions, receive settlements, apply for a loan & much more.

Once your account is activated, you can instantly download the payment QR sticker & start accepting digital payments at your store. You can also order free QR stickers & have them delivered to your store, across India.

Key Benefits of PhonePe Business App

Easy payment acceptance:
Use the PhonePe QR to accept payments from all BHIM UPI apps. The PhonePe QR also supports other payment modes like Credit & Debit Card & Wallets.

Get instant help:
Resolve queries using our user-friendly Chat Bot in the Help section. You can also reach out to our helpdesk on the PhonePe Business app.

Direct settlement into your bank account:
Money is transferred safely & directly into your bank account instantly or next morning. You can also use our ‘SettleNow’ feature to receive money in your bank account any time during the day.

Real-time transactions & payments tracking:
Check your transactions & settlements easily in the History section on the PhonePe Business app.

Get Instant Loan for Merchants:
The PhonePe Business app provides online loans to MSMEs. Get a loan on PhonePe & move a step closer to growing your business.

in_scope.instructions:
share.market app is a stockbroking app developed by PhonePe. 
You need to register with an Indian phone number to start trading.

General Description:

🚀 HOW TO START YOUR SHARE MARKET JOURNEY

✓ Download this online trading app and sign up with your mobile number
✓ Complete KYC online for demat and trading account activation
✓ Add funds via UPI, net banking, or cards
✓ Begin stock trading, mutual fund investing, or apply for IPO

Your trusted online trading app for stock trading, mutual funds, IPO investment, F&O trading, and demat account opening. Start your investing journey with India's most secure SEBI-registered trading platform backed by PhonePe.

Open a free demat account online, trade stocks with real-time Sensex and Nifty 50 updates, invest in mutual funds SIP, apply for IPO, and build wealth with complete market intelligence.

🚀Share.Market is your one app to invest & trade in:

Stock Market
Futures and Options Trading (F&O)
IPO
ETF
Mutual Fund

📊 STOCK MARKET TRADING - Buy & Sell Shares

Your complete stock invest platform for the share bazaar:
✓ Stock Trading App: Trade stocks on NSE & BSE with live market data
✓ Demat Account Opening: Open demat account online in minutes with instant KYC - completely free
✓ Intraday Trading App: Execute intraday trading with advanced charts and indicators
✓ Best Demat Account: Zero charges for your demat trading account
✓ Track Sensex app data, Nifty 50 indices, and create custom watchlists
✓ Portfolio tracking with detailed analytics

💰 MUTUAL FUND INVESTMENT - Grow Your Wealth

Complete mutual fund app for wealth building:
✓ Mutual Funds SIP: Start SIP investments from just ₹100 and build long-term wealth
✓ Investment App: Explore equity funds, debt funds, hybrid schemes based on your goals
✓ Automated SIP: Set up monthly SIP investments for wealth accumulation
✓ Fund Comparison: Compare mutual fund returns and performance
✓ SIP Calculator: Plan your mutual funds sip journey with calculators

⚡ F&O TRADING - Futures & Options

Advanced fno trading app for derivatives market:
✓ Option Trading: Trade stock futures and options with option chain analysis
✓ F&O Tools: Real-time option chain data, Greeks, and volatility indicators
✓ Hedging Strategies: Protect your stock market portfolio
✓ Technical Analysis: Advanced charting tools for trading strategies

🎯 IPO INVESTMENT - New Opportunities

Complete ipo app for mainboard and SME offerings:
✓ IPO Application: Apply for ipo directly with UPI facility
✓ IPO Allotment Status: Check your ipo allotment status instantly
✓ IPO Premium: Track grey market premium for upcoming IPOs
✓ IPO Calendar: Stay updated on IPO investment opportunities

📈 ETF & WEALTHBASKETS - Diversified Investing

Smart investment solutions for diversification:
✓ ETF Trading: Invest in exchange-traded funds tracking indices and sectors
✓ WealthBaskets: Curated portfolios starting ₹1,000 with stocks and ETFs
✓ Theme-Based: Technology, pharma, banking, and emerging sectors
